items.title: 8% mortgage rates are ‘not an impossibility’ as the 30-year fixed rate surges
items.description: With the 10-year Treasury up sharply and the outlook for the U.S. economy looking unclear, some say 8% mortgage rates are back on the table.

items.title: Why investors aren’t buying yet another attempt by the Treasury to calm the rattled bond market
items.description: Back-to-back weak auctions for Treasury notes show that government repurchases haven’t spurred demand for bonds.

items.title: Costco earnings beat expectations, thanks to tariff refunds
items.description: Tariff refunds helped deliver a profit beat during Costco’s fourth quarter.

items.title: Here’s how to position your portfolio for the next AI wave, according to Morgan Stanley
items.description: There’s still room for AI hardware stocks to rise,  but analysts at Morgan Stanley say it’s time to diversify into a wide variety of industries that are starting to realize AI benefits.

items.title: Stop trying to beat the market: Even the richest Americans can’t do it consistently
items.description: The 400 richest Americans would collectively have performed better over the past 12 months had they invested their net worths in an S&P 500 index fund.

items.title: Oracle’s stock is falling as investors fear a data-center setback
items.description: A recent report noted that Oracle is looking to protect itself from paying some expenses if a high-profile data-center project gets delayed.

items.title: Companies keep raising prices. The Fed is trying to get them to reconsider.
items.description: Inflation pressures have been so persistent this year in part because businesses have been able to pass along higher prices to consumers.

items.title: The government canceled her student loans due to a scam — but $72,000 is still on her credit report
items.description: The government continues to report to credit bureaus $4.6 billion in student debt owed by some 300,000 borrowers that should have been canceled, a lawsuit claims.

items.title: The case against buying and holding stocks for the long term
items.description: The number of stocks outperforming the index over time is shrinking, increasing the need for active managers to be nimble.
